# WhatsApp
> Secure, reliable private messaging and calling for individuals and businesses across phones and desktop devices.

WhatsApp provides end-to-end encrypted messaging, voice and video calling, group communication, status sharing, channels, and business messaging tools. This file highlights the main product pages, support resources, business platform documentation, and official updates across whatsapp.com and related official subdomains.

## Core Product
- [Home](https://www.whatsapp.com/): Main overview of WhatsApp messaging, calling, privacy, and platform availability.
- [Download](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Download WhatsApp for Android, iPhone, Mac, Windows, and other supported platforms.
- [Messaging](https://www.whatsapp.com/messaging): Overview of private messaging features, media sharing, and secure conversations.
- [Calling](https://www.whatsapp.com/calling): Overview of voice and video calling features across devices.
- [Groups](https://www.whatsapp.com/groups): Group chat features for coordinating conversations with multiple participants.
- [Status](https://www.whatsapp.com/status): Status sharing feature for photos, videos, and text updates.
- [Channels](https://www.whatsapp.com/channels): Broadcast-style channels for following updates from people and organizations.
- [Meta AI](https://www.whatsapp.com/meta-ai): Information about Meta AI experiences available in WhatsApp.

## Privacy and Security
- [Security](https://www.whatsapp.com/security): Security overview including encryption, account protection, and safety features.
- [Privacy](https://www.whatsapp.com/privacy): Privacy principles, controls, and explanations of data handling practices.
- [Security Advisories](https://www.whatsapp.com/security/advisories): Official security advisories and vulnerability disclosures from WhatsApp.
- [Legal](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal): Central index for WhatsApp legal terms, policies, and notices.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service): Terms governing use of WhatsApp consumer services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy): Detailed privacy policy for WhatsApp services and data practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/cookies): Information about cookies and similar technologies used by WhatsApp.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://faq.whatsapp.com/): Main support portal for WhatsApp apps, accounts, and troubleshooting.
- [About WhatsApp Web and Desktop](https://faq.whatsapp.com/1317564962315842): Help article for using WhatsApp on web and desktop.
- [How to log in or out](https://faq.whatsapp.com/684051319521343): Instructions for logging in and out of WhatsApp accounts.
- [About end-to-end encryption](https://faq.whatsapp.com/820124435853543): Explanation of how end-to-end encryption works in WhatsApp.
- [About privacy settings](https://faq.whatsapp.com/393237251622758): Help article covering profile, status, and last seen privacy controls.
- [About disappearing messages](https://faq.whatsapp.com/673193694148537): Overview of disappearing messages and related settings.
- [About two-step verification](https://faq.whatsapp.com/1920866721452534): Instructions for enabling and managing two-step verification.
- [Contact WhatsApp](https://faq.whatsapp.com/820124435853543/?helpref=faq_content): Entry point for getting additional support through official help flows.

## Apps and Platforms
- [Download Overview](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Official app downloads for mobile and desktop platforms.
- [WhatsApp Web](https://web.whatsapp.com/): Browser-based access to WhatsApp linked from a mobile device.
- [Android App on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.whatsapp): Official Android app listing for WhatsApp Messenger.
- [iPhone App on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/whatsapp-messenger/id310633997): Official iPhone app listing for WhatsApp Messenger.
- [Mac App on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/whatsapp-messenger/id1147396723): Official macOS app listing for WhatsApp.
- [Windows App](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Download page for the native Windows desktop application.

- [WhatsApp Business App](https://business.whatsapp.com/products/business-app): Information about the small business app for customer communication.
- [WhatsApp Business Platform](https://business.whatsapp.com/products/platform): Overview of the API-based platform for scaled business messaging.

- [Get Started](https://business.whatsapp.com/get-started): Entry page for adopting WhatsApp business solutions.

## Business Platform Documentation
- [Developer Documentation Home](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp): Official developer hub for WhatsApp business platform documentation.
- [Cloud API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api): Documentation for the hosted WhatsApp Cloud API.
- [On-Premises API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/on-premises): Documentation for self-hosted WhatsApp Business Platform deployments.
- [Embedded Signup](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/embedded-signup): Guide for onboarding businesses through embedded signup flows.
- [Business Management API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api): API reference for managing WhatsApp business assets and accounts.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/webhooks): Webhook setup and event handling for WhatsApp Cloud API integrations.
- [Messages Reference](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/reference/messages): API reference for sending WhatsApp message types.
- [Phone Numbers](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/reference/phone-numbers): API reference for managing business phone numbers.
